tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Find QBCore APIs, qb-* resources, setup and troubleshooting references. Returns bounded excerpts, canonical citations and recorded source-review metadata. Use docs_get for complete code.

tools.name: docs_get
tools.description: Read Markdown at a canonical path returned by docs_search or docs_list. Follow nextOffset until null to obtain the complete article. Does not fetch arbitrary URLs.

tools.name: docs_list
tools.description: Browse the canonical documentation catalog by scope with deterministic pagination. Follow nextOffset until null.
